verdict.rationale: Whether user data is excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for a cloud password manager, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-use commitment about AI. Locally run vault reports and self-hosting are adjacent privacy features, not a documented control over AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
